title: PyQchem: A Python interface for Q-Chem
description:
PyQchem is a Python library designed to provide a simple and flexible interface to the Q-Chem quantum chemistry software. It allows users to define molecular structures and quantum chemistry calculations directly from Python, execute Q-Chem calculations, and retrieve structured results through a collection of specialized output parsers.

PyQchem is designed to facilitate the integration of quantum chemistry calculations into Python-based computational workflows, providing tools for managing calculations, handling molecular structures, and processing electronic structure data.

Features
- Simple and clean Python interface for defining and executing Q-Chem calculations
- Automatic detection and use of the Q-Chem environment
- Specialized output parsers for different types of quantum chemistry calculations
- Support for custom basis sets and initial electronic structure guesses
- Calculation caching system powered by SQLite
- Tools for handling molecular geometries and electronic structure data
- Integration with external Python libraries and computational workflows
- Optional compatibility with wfnsympy, paramiko, and pymatgen

Requirements
- NumPy
- SciPy
- Matplotlib
- Requests
- lxml

Installation
PyQchem can be installed from the Python Package Index using pip:

pip install pyqchem

Documentation and source code
Documentation: https://pyqchem.readthedocs.io/
Source code: https://github.com/abelcarreras/PyQchem
